title: fix(plugin-kanban): key a reference swimlane by its id and title it by the record's name
body:

Fixes #36841
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Tests: on head `1b3daca9d67`, `ObjectKanban.referenceSwimlanes-36841.test.tsx` (4/4), the whole `packages/plugin-kanban/` suite (Test Files 85/85, Tests 567/567), and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` type-check (exit 0).

## 维护者速读

- 看板按查找字段(如"客户"、"负责人")分泳道时,泳道标题从一串 "[object Object]" 变成对应记录的名称,不同记录的卡片分进各自的泳道。
- 属于看板泳道体验修复:看板按引用字段分列时已修好这一问题,这次把同样的做法用到泳道上。
- 出错时最坏是泳道标题显示记录编号而非名称,或泳道顺序变化;不涉及数据写入,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`, one file of code:

- A swimlane is keyed by `swimlaneKeyOf`, which calls `laneKeyOf` from `kanbanReferenceLanes.ts`: the helper that keys the column lanes on a reference field. An expanded reference (the record `$expand` returns) is keyed by its id. A missing value, and an expanded record with no id, go to the Uncategorized swimlane. Any other value keeps the key it had before: `String(value)`.
- That one key does every swimlane job: bucketing cards into cells, the row count, the sort, the React key, the drop-reason element id, the lane rows reported to `onLaneRowsChange`, and the collapsed set kept under `objectui:kanban-collapsed:FIELD`. The board used to repeat the same stringify expression in four places. Now they all call `swimlaneOf`.
- The heading comes from `lanesFromRecords`, the helper that titles the column lanes. It reads the field's `displayField`, taken from `objectFields` only when the field names its `reference` (the rule `ObjectKanban` applies to a column lane), then the shared title ladder `referencedRecordTitle` over the expanded record, then the id. The Uncategorized swimlane is still drawn from `kanban.uncategorized`.

## Tests

- New file `ObjectKanban.referenceSwimlanes-36841.test.tsx`. It drives a real `ObjectKanban` (rows shaped as `$expand` returns them, columns from a select field) swimlaned by a lookup field and by a user field:
  - (a) one swimlane per account, titled by `displayField`, each cell holding that account's cards, the empty value in Uncategorized, and no `[object Object]` anywhere;
  - (b) a user field with no `displayField` is titled off the expanded record;
  - (c) the swimlanes sort by id: the ids are set opposite to the titles, so a title sort fails;
  - (d) collapsing writes the id to the browser store, and a remount reads it back.

<details><summary>Ablations (each run by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit 1 to 0, blob moved, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- Keying: `swimlaneKeyOf` body changed to `return String(value)`. Tests 4 failed (4): (a) through (d) all red. Restored, blob `bcf0aadada6c` equals HEAD.
- Title: `title: titles.get(key) ?? key` changed to `title: key`. Tests 4 failed (4). Restored, blob `bcf0aadada6c` equals HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The cross-swimlane write-back point does not hold on `main` as the card states it.** Nothing on the board writes a swimlane value. `KanbanBoard`'s drop handler calls `onCardMove(cardId, fromColumnId, toColumnId, index)` and passes no swimlane. `useCrossSwimlaneMove` writes nothing itself: it checks `acceptFrom` and hands the caller's own lane ids to the caller's `onCardMove`. It is exported from `index.tsx`, and no file in the repo calls it. So there is no write-back to fix, and this PR does not touch `useCrossSwimlaneMove.ts`. A host that builds that hook's `swimlanes` from `lanesFromRecords` gets the reference id as `toSwimlane`, because that helper keys by the id.
- **Title rung not reached:** the target object's declared `nameField`. A column lane gets it because `ObjectKanban` reads the `groupBy` field's target object schema. The board makes no such read for the swimlane field, and the card's file surface does not include `ObjectKanban.tsx`. So a swimlane on a target whose name lives in a field with no name-like key, and with no `displayField` on the field, is titled by its id. No per-card read was added. Follow-up: none filed; the gap is in the seat report.
- Collapsed-swimlane entries stored before this change under the text `[object Object]` no longer match any swimlane and are ignored.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: the `swimlanes` memo and `swimlaneKeyOf` in `KanbanImpl.tsx`, and then the swimlane render loop that uses `swimlaneOf`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.referenceSwimlanes-36841.test.tsx`. Expect `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
